reviews.review:
Basically, it's a very hard twin stick shooter and plays a bit like "20 minutes till dawn". No auto aim. There's a little bit of meta progression, including unlocking new orbs (characters). Each orb plays a bit different. Some are more close combat, others have a bit more range.

After struggling for hours, not understanding what to do, I was about to give up. There's no real tutorial. No explanation of goals. No indication of where you are, progress wise. And it's freaking hard. But the action is tense and there IS some actual logic to it. After six hours I was finally able to sort of finish a run.

So yeah, it's a great game once you figure what to do exactly.

One major pain in the behind: there are a few endless sanctums. If you enter, they seem to go on forever in all directions. Problem is, the portal to return to the main map after achieving the goal for that area always appears right where you originally started. And it can be very hard to find after wandering off. The map does wrap around eventually and the portal makes a noticable noise when you come closer though.
